AND AWARD DATED 15.02.2021 PASSED IN MVC NO.69/2016 ON THE FILE OF THE ADDITIONAL SENIOR CIVIL JUDGE AND ADDITIONAL MOTOR ACCIDENT CLAIMS TRIBUNAL, HANGAL, PARTLY ALLOWING THE CLAIM PETITION FOR COMPENSATION AND SEEKING ENHANCEMENT OF COMPENSATION.

THIS MISCELLANEOUS FIRST APPEAL COMING ON FOR CONCILIAT ION B EFORE LOK ADALAT AFTER B EIN G REFERRED BY T HE COURT, THE FOL LOWING CONCILIAT ION ORDER IS PASSED:
CONCILIAT ION OR DER Learned counsel for claimant and representative of respondent-Insurance Company along with its counsel are present.
Shri. Bangareppa S/O Basappa ... vs The Divisional Manager on 13 July, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74353688/
1 2. After prolonged negotiations, matter is settled.

Claimant has agreed to receive and the respondent- Insurance Company has agreed to pay a global compensation of Rs.1,10,000/- (One Lakh Ten Thousand Rupees only), in addition to what has been awarded by the Tribunal, in full and final settlement of the claim as global compensation.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.

3. Respondent-Insurance Company has agreed to deposit the said amount before Tribunal within SIX weeks from the date of preparation of Award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
4. On deposit, the entire amount shall be released in favour of claimants in the ratio fixed by the Tribunal, forthwith.
5. Miscellaneous First Appeal stands disposed of in terms of Joint Memo.
Award of Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
Draw up the award accordingly.
The amount in deposit, if any, shall be transmitted to the concerned Tribunal, forthwith.
